newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Alaska Milk up 7.02 pct at 3.05 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Alaska Milk up 7.02 pct at 3.05 pesos.

text.p: Alaska Milk Corporation gained 20 centavos, or 7.02 percent, to 3.05 pesos at midsession on Wednesday on buying triggered by an overall recovery in the food sector, brokers said.
"The recovery of the food and beverage sector is helping the stock and foreigners like plays involving consumer stocks," Noel Reyes, Anscor Hagedorn Securities Inc research head, said.
Urbancorp Securities Inc said in a research paper that Alaska's introduction of new milk products by year-end will improve the plant capacity utilization rates of the company.
"Alaska never lost money but because of the warm reception for the beverage sector, people expect better bottomline for the company," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Citisecurities Inc.
